gloss: the whole country; all over the nation

definitions.gloss: the whole country; all over the nation
definitions.explanation: Every part of a country, considered as a whole. Often used to mean that something spread or happened nationwide.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国中|くにじゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{流行|はや}った→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧。
examples.english: That song became popular all over the country.

examples.japanese: {国中|くにじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沸|わ}いた→沸く：01122_waku⟧。
examples.english: The whole country was thrilled by the news of the championship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{国中|くにじゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: After the big earthquake, relief supplies arrived from all over the country.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧ (country) + the suffix 〜{中|じゅう}, which attaches to a place noun to mean 'all over' or 'throughout'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国中|くにじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread across the whole country
- {国中|くにじゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a topic nationwide

USAGE:
The suffix 〜{中|じゅう} marks spatial extent ('throughout a place'). Read as ちゅう it instead marks a time span ('during'). Compare ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧ (all over the world), ⟦{町中|まちじゅう}→町中：28383_machijuu⟧ (all over town).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧: the whole country — more neutral and common, especially in formal or written contexts
